basic_details.job_title: IISER Pune Project Associate II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Pune (IISER Pune) has announced vacancies under advertisement number 82/2026, including 1 Project Associate-II post within a total of 2 temporary vacancies. The appointment is purely temporary and contractual for an initial period of one year with possible extension, carrying a pay of Rs. 28,000 + 30% House Rent Allowance for candidates aged not more than 35 years as on the last date. Eligible applicants must possess a Four-year Bachelor's Degree in Electronics Engineering or Mechanical Engineering or an equivalent OR Master of Science (M.Sc.)

qualification.details: Post Qualification Required Post No. 1 & Post No. 2 Four-year Bachelor's Degree in Electronics Engineering or Mechanical Engineering or an equivalent from a recognized University / Institution. OR Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Physics or an equivalent qualification from a recognized University / Institution.

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application format available below the official advertisement on the IISER Pune website.
Fill out the application form carefully with all required details regarding educational qualifications, age, and experience.
Convert the completed application form into PDF format.
Send the application via email to [email protected] on or before 25.10.2026.
Mention exactly "Post Code, Name of the Post and Advt. No. 82/2026" in the subject line of the email.
important_instructions: The appointment is purely temporary and will terminate automatically without any notice or compensation. Appointed persons shall have no claim of appointment or absorption in IISER Pune. Photocopies of relevant certificates, testimonials in support of age, educational qualifications, experiences, and a recent passport-size color photograph will be collected and verified at an appropriate stage. No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing for the interview. Bringing any political or other influence will be treated as a disqualification. Upper age limit, educational qualification, and experience shall be determined as of the last date for submitting applications (25.10.2026).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification advertises a total of 2 vacancies across two specific project roles under Post No. 1 and Post No. 2.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Experience: 2 years of relevant experience in R&D as operation and maintenance of instruments. Preference: Candidates with experience in R&D labs will be preferred.

rows.qualification_required: Four-year Bachelor's Degree in Electronics Engineering or Mechanical Engineering or an equivalent from a recognized University / Institution. OR Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Physics or an equivalent qualification from a recognized University / Institution.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidates will receive consolidated emoluments of Rs. 28,000/- per month plus 30% House Rent Allowance (HRA). The appointment is made purely on a temporary and contractual basis, initially for a period of one year. This tenure is extendable for a further period subject to the satisfactory performance of the incumbent and the continuation of the project.

content_sections.heading: IISER Pune Project Associate-II Job Description
content_sections.text: Job Requirements for Post No. 1: The incumbent will be responsible for operating and handling FESEM, micro / nano-patterning instrumentation, and Electron Beam Lithography (EBL) systems for advanced material characterization and fabrication. Job Requirements for Post No. 2: The incumbent will be responsible for operating, maintaining, and ensuring the safe and efficient functioning of Liquid Helium Plant and various cryogenic systems.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely temporary and will terminate automatically without any notice or compensation. Appointed persons shall have no claim of appointment or absorption in IISER Pune. Photocopies of relevant certificates, testimonials in support of age, educational qualifications, experiences, and a recent passport-size color photograph will be collected and verified at an appropriate stage. No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing for the interview. Bringing any political or other influence will be treated as a disqualification. Upper age limit, educational qualification, and experience shall be determined as of the last date for submitting applications (25.10.2026).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under Advertisement No. 82/2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies are available, comprising 1 post for Project Associate-II under Post No. 1 and 1 post under Post No. 2.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IISER Pune Project Associate-II posts?
faq.answer: The last date to send applications by email is 25.10.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Four-year Bachelor's Degree in Electronics Engineering or Mechanical Engineering or equivalent, OR a Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Physics or equivalent qualification from a recognized University or Institution, along with 2 years of relevant R&D experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must not be more than 35 years of age as on the last date of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates receive consolidated emoluments of Rs. 28,000/- per month plus 30% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their applications by email in PDF format to [email protected] on or before 25.10.2026.

faq.question: Q8. What subject line should be written in the email application?
faq.answer: Candidates must write "Post Code, Name of the Post and Advt. No. 82/2026" in the subject line of the email.

faq.question: Q9. Is the appointment permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The appointment is purely temporary and contractual for an initial period of one year, extendable subject to satisfactory performance and project continuation, with no claim for regular absorption in IISER Pune.
